channel.title: Pier & Point · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Building 12 Plaza and Market Square (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Pier 70 Building 12 Plaza now uses real Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Pier 70 Building 12 Plaza now uses real Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lots 4114008 and 4114004.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.
item.description: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: The plaza's layout is now described as the D4D gives it (Market Square north of Building 12, the entry plaza south, the Maryland Street Platform on its east side), and the map notes no longer claim the site was never subdivided by the Assessor or explain the acreage gap as a fact. The 2042 completion milestone is now a soft placeholder (the 2017 Phase 3 outside date, tolled by down market delay) rather than a forecast, and the Building 15 move is dated to the 2018-2020 window the Port gives. Image credits no longer name design firms the figure does not credit or say 'adopted 2017', and Phase 1 park membership is cited to Port Item 9B.

item.title: Added · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Building 12 Plaza and Market Square added, filling its block between Buildings 2, D and 12. The event date is the Planning Commission's Aug 24, 2017 approval of the Pier 70 D4D that defines the space (Resolution 19980).
item.description: Building 12 Plaza and Market Square added, filling its block between Buildings 2, D and 12. The event date is the Planning Commission's Aug 24, 2017 approval of the Pier 70 D4D that defines the space (Resolution 19980). Source: Pier 70 D4D, Figure 6.4.2; Port Item 9B (Sept 22, 2017).

item.title: Planned · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: Port reports that although Phase 1 horizontal infrastructure and Building 12's rehabilitation are complete, construction of the balance of Phase 1, 'largely comprised of the Phase 1 parks and open space,' will be built 'on a schedule that coincides with the delivery of adjacent vertical development,' which 'has not moved forward' because of pandemic-driven office-vacancy increases, construction-cost escalation and higher financing costs (Aug 7, 2026)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07.

item.title: Expected · Building 12 Plaza and Market Square: No completion date is sourced for the plaza: its Phase 1 park schedule is tied to adjacent vertical development, which has not moved forward. The only outer bound in the documents is the 2017 DDA's whole-project Phase 3 outside date (about 2042), shown here as a soft placeholder (~2042)
